description: This file defines the LiveActivityManager class responsible for managing live activities using ActivityKit in an iOS app. It handles starting, updating, and ending live activities, ensuring connection health checks and cleanup of stale activities.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle of live activities, including starting, reconnecting, disconnecting, and cleanup of duplicates.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Starts a new live activity with specified agent name and session key, handling activity initialization and logging.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to indicating a connecting status.

methods.name: handleReconnect
methods.description: Resets the activity state to idle, indicating reconnection.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Sets the activity state to disconnected.

methods.name: hydrateCurrentAndPruneDuplicates
methods.description: Ensures only the most recent activity remains and ends any stale activities.

methods.name: updateCurrent
methods.description: Updates the current activity's state with provided status information.

methods.name: connectingState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state indicating connecting.

methods.name: idleState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state indicating idle.

methods.name: disconnectedState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state indicating disconnected.
